part2.question: An important river/lake in your country

segments.v: I want to talk about the Red River. It is a very important river in the north of Vietnam. It starts in China and it flows through Hà Nội to the sea. It is about 1,150 kilometres long. The water is red-brown because it has a lot of mud. The river is very wide and there are many bridges across it, like Long Biên Bridge. It is important because it gives water for rice fields. The Red River Delta is very good for growing rice. It is also important in the history of Hà Nội. But sometimes there are floods, so people built dykes. When I was a child, I flew kites near the river.

grammar.band6: “it has a lot of mud” (it carries silt).
grammar.band9: Passive (it's crossed by several famous bridges), participle phrase (referring to the bend…), relative clause with present perfect (which has fed northern Vietnam for thousands of years), and present perfect continuous idea (For centuries, people have built dykes…).

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 “it has a lot of mud” is less precise than “it carries silt”. Band 9 covers geography, appearance and importance with precise vocabulary, explains the meaning of “Hà Nội”, and balances benefits with danger.
